result.title: Dual-Stage Channel-Posterior Integration for MLM-Aided Token Communications
result.comment: 6 pages, 5 figures, This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
result.summary: Token transmission over conventional digital modulation is vulnerable to channel impairments, leading to bit errors that cause received tokens to become contextually inconsistent. This paper proposes a receiver-side dual-stage channel-posterior integration framework for masked language model (MLM)-aided token reconstruction. In the proposed framework, the receiver detects unreliable token positions from channel reliability and constructs a vocabulary-level channel-posterior. In particular, within the receiver, Posterior-Weighted Input Embedding (PWE) injects this posterior into the MLM input, while Adaptive Output Logit Fusion (AOF) reuses it at the output with a channel-adaptive weight. Consequently, multiple unreliable tokens can be reconstructed in a single bidirectional MLM inference without retransmission, transmitter-side encoding, or additional MLM training. Experiments over noisy channels show up to a $67.2$\% improvement in cosine similarity over context-only MLM reconstruction, with consistent gains across different MLM architectures and existing language-model-aided methods.

AI.brief_summary: 该文面向噪声信道下的 token 传输，提出接收端双阶段信道后验融合框架：由信道可靠性定位不可靠 token 并构造词表级后验，经 PWE 注入 MLM 输入嵌入、经 AOF 以信道自适应权重融合到输出 logits，从而单次双向推理重建多个错误 token。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按可靠性把外部证据加权注入输入嵌入、再与输出分布自适应融合」的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据的可信度筛选与 latent 状态注入、输出侧证据融合提供可核查的机制线索，但任务与目标差异较大。
